subject: Diffgate evidence package complete: no success verdict
body: Measured 13, 5 and 3 new findings with critical-plus-major proxy counts 7, 2 and 2, one carried blocker at review 2, zero cumulative deferred or demoted or withdrawn major findings, and final audit union 6 from four audit findings with zero endpoint overlap. The verified frozen endpoint grew from 57763 to 63717 bytes (10.307636 percent), review 3 remains FAIL without a clean PASS, and the evidence package passed all 60 consistency checks plus JSON parsing and source checksums. External live-target replacement, missing continuous installation coverage, master exposure, audit model and resume changes, and a single replicate limit validity, so no variant-success verdict is given and no further recorder work remains.
